Data.Persona: Enterprise Architect, AI Architect and Business Analyst

ToneOptions.Label: Strategic & Authoritative
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Maintain a strategic and authoritative tone, guiding multi-cloud architectural decisions with confidence.

ToneOptions.Label: Analytical & Prescriptive
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Adopt an analytical and prescriptive tone, detailing technical recommendations for multi-cloud integration.

ToneOptions.Label: Balanced & Risk-Aware
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Employ a balanced, risk-aware tone, addressing multi-cloud benefits while mitigating potential challenges.

ToneOptions.Label: Forward-Looking & Innovative
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Utilize a forward-looking and innovative tone, emphasizing future-readiness and AI/ML advancements.

GoalOptions.Label: Validate Multi-Cloud Strategy
GoalOptions.Text: For the Enterprise Architect, this document aims to validate the proposed multi-cloud strategy, ensuring alignment with enterprise objectives and architectural principles. It should confirm the technical feasibility and strategic benefits of integrating a secondary hyperscaler for AI/ML workloads.

GoalOptions.Label: Guide Technical Implementation
GoalOptions.Text: For the Development and DevOps teams, the goal is to provide clear, actionable technical guidance for implementing the multi-cloud solution. This includes detailed architectural patterns, integration points, and operational considerations for AI/ML and data-intensive workloads.

GoalOptions.Label: Inform Business Decisions
GoalOptions.Text: For Business stakeholders, this document seeks to articulate the business value and strategic advantages of the multi-cloud approach, particularly for AI/ML innovation and risk mitigation. It should provide a clear understanding of the investment justification and expected outcomes.

GoalOptions.Label: Establish Governance Framework
GoalOptions.Text: For the AI Architect and Enterprise Architect, the objective is to establish a robust governance framework for multi-cloud operations, extending existing Azure controls. This includes defining policies, security standards, and operational models for managing AI/ML services across hyperscalers.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical & Architectural Alignment
Criteria: Solution aligns with existing Azure Landing Zone and governance model.
Secondary hyperscaler selection criteria are clearly defined and justified for AI/ML.
Proposed integration patterns support seamless data flow and workload portability.
Scalability and resilience requirements for AI/ML workloads are adequately addressed.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Business Value & Risk Mitigation
Criteria: Demonstrates clear ROI and strategic benefits for AI/ML innovation and market differentiation.
Effectively mitigates vendor concentration risk and enhances business continuity.
Cost implications and optimization strategies for multi-cloud operations are transparent.
Supports future business growth and adaptability to evolving AI/ML technologies.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Operational & Security Readiness
Criteria: Defines clear operational models and responsibilities for multi-cloud management.
Ensures robust security controls and compliance across all cloud environments.
Provides a clear roadmap for skill development and organizational readiness.
Includes a comprehensive plan for monitoring, logging, and incident response in a multi-cloud context.
